Workflow:
1. upload dataset files from your directory e.g. path/to/your/simulation_data (uploads should be in order form sh_m_full_sim_1.csv to sh_m_full_sim_180.csv)
2. create separate data sets for a) all animals, b) animals with PAC, and c) animals without PAC
3. Create demo tables and save into your output directory e.g. path/to/your/output_directory
4. Create average tables and save into your output directory e.g. path/to/your/output_directory

These datasets should already have columns for all corrections performed in the manuscript include univariate and multivariate uncorrected EBVs, univariate and multivariate residual corrections, univariate and multivariate raw corrections, and univariate and multivariate deregressed corrections. 

Datasets uploaded should include the following column names though other redundant columns for working are fine. Notes for particular columns are labelled with an arrow (<-) alongside the description of what correction it refers to in the manuscript. 
id
sire
dam
bw.tbv <- live weight true breeding value
fi.tbv <- feed intake true breeding value
ch4.tbv
co2.tbv
ych4.tbv <- methane yield true breeding value 
yco2.tbv
ch4.p.x
co2.p.x
dch4_uEBV <- uncorrected univariate daily methane EBV 
dch4_uEBV_rel <- uncorrected univariate daily methane EBV reliability
dch4_mEBV <- uncorrected multivariate daily methane EBV
dch4_mEBV_rel <- uncorrected multivariate daily methane EBV reliability
r1_uEBV <- residual univariate daily methane corrected for live weight
r2_uEBV <- residual univariate daily methane corrected for co2
r3_uEBV <- residual univariate daily methane corrected for live weight and co2
r1_mEBV <- residual multivariate daily methane corrected for live weight
r2_mEBV <- residual multivariate daily methane corrected for co2
r3_mEBV <- residual multivariate daily methane corrected for live weight ad co2
u_dch4_adj_bw <- raw correction univariate daily methane corrected for live weight

u_d3_CH4gBV_LW <- deregressed univariate daily methane corrected for live weight

```{r, eval=FALSE}
# upload files
# ---- User-defined paths (edit these to match your local setup) ----
data_dir <- "path/to/your/simulation_data"     # folder containing sh_m_full_sim_1.csv ... sh_m_full_sim_180.csv
out_dir  <- "path/to/your/output_directory"    # where demo and average tables will be written

# Get only files matching sh_m_full_sim_#.csv
files <- list.files(
  path = data_dir,
  pattern = "^sh_m_full_sim_[0-9]+\\.csv$",
  full.names = TRUE
)

# Extract simulation number and sort numerically
sim_num <- as.integer(sub("^sh_m_full_sim_([0-9]+)\\.csv$", "\\1", basename(files)))
files <- files[order(sim_num)]
sim_num <- sim_num[order(sim_num)]

# Optional check
print(head(basename(files), 10))
print(tail(basename(files), 10))

# Read each file and assign into Global Environment as sh_m_full_sim_1 ... sh_m_full_sim_180
for (i in seq_along(files)) {
  obj_name <- paste0("sh_m_full_sim_", sim_num[i])
  assign(obj_name, fread(files[i]), envir = .GlobalEnv)
  message(sprintf("Loaded %s", obj_name))
}

# Final check
loaded_objs <- ls(pattern = "^sh_m_full_sim_[0-9]+$", envir = .GlobalEnv)
loaded_nums <- as.integer(sub("^sh_m_full_sim_", "", loaded_objs))
loaded_objs <- loaded_objs[order(loaded_nums)]

cat("Number of datasets loaded:", length(loaded_objs), "\n")
cat("First loaded object:", loaded_objs[1], "\n")
cat("Last loaded object:", loaded_objs[length(loaded_objs)], "\n")
```

```{r}
# --- Step 1: Copy sh_m_full_sim_1 .. sh_m_full_sim_180 to full_0_sim_1 .. full_0_sim_180 ----
for (i in 1:180) {
  src_name <- paste0("sh_m_full_sim_", i)
  dst_name <- paste0("full_0_sim_", i)
  
  df <- get0(src_name, ifnotfound = NULL, envir = .GlobalEnv)
  if (is.null(df)) {
    message(sprintf("⚠️ %s not found; skipping copy.", src_name))
    next
  }
  
  assign(dst_name, df, envir = .GlobalEnv)
  message(sprintf("✅ Copied %s → %s (%d rows, %d cols)",
                  src_name, dst_name, nrow(df), ncol(df)))
}
```

```{r}
# --- Base: pull full_0_sim_1..180 safely into a list ----------------------------
base_names <- paste0("full_0_sim_", 1:180)
base_list  <- mget(base_names,
                   ifnotfound = as.list(rep(list(NULL), length(base_names))),
                   envir = .GlobalEnv)
names(base_list) <- base_names

# keeping base list and full_0_sim_list separate so as to not overwrite
full_list <- mget(paste0("full_0_sim_", 1:180),
                        ifnotfound = as.list(rep(list(NULL), 180)),
                        envir = .GlobalEnv)

# helper: robust logical filter builder
has_col <- function(df, col) !is.null(df) && is.data.frame(df) && col %in% names(df)

# --- 1) WITH PAC: keep rows where ch4.p.x is not NA ---------------------------
pac_sim_list <- imap(base_list, function(df, nm) {
  if (!has_col(df, "ch4.p.x")) {
    message(sprintf("ℹ️ %s: no ch4.p.x; returning NULL.", nm))
    return(NULL)
  }
  out <- df[!is.na(df$ch4.p.x), , drop = FALSE]
  if (!nrow(out)) {
    message(sprintf("ℹ️ %s: with-PAC filter produced 0 rows.", nm))
    return(NULL)
  }
  out
})
names(pac_sim_list) <- base_names

# --- 2) WITHOUT PAC: keep rows where ch4.p.x is NA ----------------------------
nopac_sim_list <- imap(base_list, function(df, nm) {
  if (!has_col(df, "ch4.p.x")) {
    message(sprintf("ℹ️ %s: no ch4.p.x; returning NULL.", nm))
    return(NULL)
  }
  out <- df[is.na(df$ch4.p.x), , drop = FALSE]
  if (!nrow(out)) {
    message(sprintf("ℹ️ %s: no-PAC filter produced 0 rows.", nm))
    return(NULL)
  }
  out
})
names(nopac_sim_list) <- base_names

# --- 3) SIRES: per-simulation data of all sire animals (full rows) ----------
sire_list <- purrr::imap(base_list, function(df, nm) {
  # basic checks
  if (is.null(df) || !all(c("id", "sire") %in% names(df))) {
    message(sprintf("ℹ️ %s: missing 'id' or 'sire' column; returning NULL.", nm))
    return(NULL)
  }

  # Work in character space so numeric/character mix doesn't bite us
  id_chr   <- as.character(df$id)
  sire_chr <- as.character(df$sire)

  # Sire IDs are those that appear in the 'sire' column (excluding 0 / NA)
  sire_ids <- unique(sire_chr[!is.na(sire_chr) & sire_chr != "0"])

  if (!length(sire_ids)) {
    message(sprintf("ℹ️ %s: no sires identified (no non-zero 'sire' IDs); returning NULL.", nm))
    return(NULL)
  }

  # Keep only rows where the animal itself is a sire
  out <- df[id_chr %in% sire_ids, , drop = FALSE]

  if (!nrow(out)) {
    message(sprintf("ℹ️ %s: sire IDs found but no matching 'id' rows; returning NULL.", nm))
    return(NULL)
  }

  out
})

names(sire_list) <- base_names


# --- Quick summaries ----------------------------------------------------------
cat(sprintf("pac_sim_list:    %d non-NULL of %d\n",
            sum(!vapply(pac_sim_list, is.null, logical(1))), length(pac_sim_list)))
cat(sprintf("nopac_sim_list:  %d non-NULL of %d\n",
            sum(!vapply(nopac_sim_list, is.null, logical(1))), length(nopac_sim_list)))
cat(sprintf("sire_list:       %d non-NULL of %d\n",
            sum(!vapply(sire_list, is.null, logical(1))), length(sire_list)))
```

Now we need to create a demo_table which is all the averages of results. 

1) Function - pick_col
Given a simulation data frame (sh_m_full_sim_1 to sh_m_full_sim_180) and one (or more) candidate x-variable names, pick the first one that actually exists – or fail loudly if none do.


2) Function - lm_stats
takes a TBV vector (x) and an EBV/adjusted EBV vector (y) and creates linear models for these. It removes missing data, then calculates accuracy metrics (correlation, R²), calibration metrics (slope (b1) and intercept (b0)), and error metrics (bias = mean(y–x) and RMSE). 


3) Function - find_y_cols
identifies which EBV-related columns are present in a simulation dataset. It compares the dataset’s column names against a predefined whitelist of all EBV types used in the analysis and returns only the matching variables.


4) Function - sumarise_one 
The function summarise_one() computes all accuracy and bias statistics for a single simulation and a single TBV trait. It takes:
- a dataset (df),
- the simulation ID (sim_id),
- the TBV column of interest (x_col),
and compares that TBV to every EBV-type column returned by find_y_cols().

For each EBV column, it calculates:
- R^2
- Pearson correlation
- Regression slope (b1)
- Regression intercept (b0)
- Bias (mean(EBV − TBV))
- RMSE

The function returns one row per simulation × TBV combination, with all metrics stored as separate columns. If no relevant EBV columns are found, it returns only the simulation ID and TBV name.




Codes
u_d3_CH4gBV_LW - This was using the subtraction adjustment
u_d1_CH4gBV_LW - This was using the residual adjustment (changed from u_d3_CH4gBV_LW to u_d1_CH4gBV_LW)

```{r}
  # ---------- helpers ----------
  # 1)
  pick_col <- function(df, candidates) {
    nm <- candidates[candidates %in% names(df)]
    if (!length(nm)) stop("None of ", paste(candidates, collapse = ", "), " found in df.")
    nm[1]
  }
  
  # 2)
  lm_stats <- function(x, y) {
    ok <- is.finite(x) & is.finite(y)
    n  <- sum(ok)
    if (n == 0) {
      return(c(r2 = NA_real_, corr = NA_real_, b1 = NA_real_, b0 = NA_real_,
               bias = NA_real_, rmse = NA_real_))
    }
  
    xok <- x[ok]; yok <- y[ok]
    err   <- xok - yok
    bias  <- mean(err)
    rmse  <- sqrt(mean(err^2))
    r_val <- suppressWarnings(cor(xok, yok))  # Pearson r
  
    if (n < 2) {
      return(c(r2 = NA_real_, corr = r_val, b1 = NA_real_, b0 = NA_real_,
               bias = bias, rmse = rmse))
    }
  
    fit <- suppressWarnings(lm(xok ~ yok))
    s   <- summary(fit)
  
    c(r2   = unname(s$r.squared),
      corr = r_val,
      b1   = unname(coef(fit)[2]),
      b0   = unname(coef(fit)[1]),
      bias = bias,
      rmse = rmse)
  }
  
  # discover all EBV columns of interest
  find_y_cols <- function(df) {
    all_names <- names(df)
  
    base_u <- c("bw_uEBV", "dch4_uEBV", "dco2_uEBV")
    resids_u <- c("r1_uEBV","r2_uEBV","r3_uEBV")
    adj0_u <- c("u_dch4_adj_bw", "u_dch4_adj_dco2", "u_dch4_adj_bw_dco2")
    adj_d3_u <- c("u_d1_CH4gBV_LW" , "u_d1_CH4gBV_CO2", "u_d1_CH4gBV_LW_CO2")
    
    base_m <- c("bw_mEBV", "dch4_mEBV", "dco2_mEBV")
    resids_m <- c("r1_mEBV","r2_mEBV","r3_mEBV")
    adj0_m <- c("m_dch4_adj_bw", "m_dch4_adj_dco2", "m_dch4_adj_bw_dco2")
    adj_d3_m <- c("m_d1_CH4gBV_LW", "m_d1_CH4gBV_CO2", "m_d1_CH4gBV_LW_CO2")
  
    y_whitelist <- unique(c(
      resids_u,
      base_u,
      adj0_u, 
      adj_d3_u,
      resids_m,
      base_m,
      adj0_m,
      adj_d3_m
    ))
  
    intersect(y_whitelist, all_names)
  }
  
  # one-simulation summarise
  summarise_one <- function(df, sim_id, x_col) {
    x_nm   <- pick_col(df, x_col)
    y_cols <- find_y_cols(df)
  
    if (!length(y_cols)) {
      return(tibble(sim = sim_id, xvar = x_col))
    }
  
    pair_stats <- purrr::imap_dfc(setNames(y_cols, y_cols), function(y_nm, tag) {
      stats <- lm_stats(df[[x_nm]], df[[y_nm]])
      tibble::tibble(
        !!paste0(tag, "_r2")    := stats["r2"],
        !!paste0(tag, "_corr")  := stats["corr"],
        !!paste0(tag, "_b1")    := stats["b1"],
        !!paste0(tag, "_b0")    := stats["b0"],
        !!paste0(tag, "_bias")  := stats["bias"],
        !!paste0(tag, "_rmse")  := stats["rmse"]
      )
    })
  
    dplyr::bind_cols(tibble(sim = sim_id, xvar = x_col), pair_stats)
  }
  

```

```{r}
# ---------- build base table over all sims & x vars ----------
x_vars <- c("bw.tbv", "fi.tbv", "ych4.tbv", "yco2.tbv")

demo_table <- dplyr::bind_rows(
  unlist(Map(function(d, i) {
    lapply(x_vars, function(xv) {
      tryCatch(
        summarise_one(d, i, x_col = xv),
        error = function(e) stop(sprintf("Error in simulation %d (x=%s): %s", i, xv, e$message), call. = FALSE)
      )
    })
  }, full_list, seq_along(full_list)), recursive = FALSE)
)
```

```{r}
# ---------- (sim cleanup, blocks, split, add Mean/sd/se/cv/min/max) ----------
# Ensure 'sim' is clean
if (!"sim" %in% names(demo_table)) {
  sim_like <- grep("^sim(\\.\\.\\d+)?$", names(demo_table), value = TRUE)
  if (length(sim_like)) names(demo_table)[match(sim_like[1], names(demo_table))] <- "sim"
}

demo_table <- demo_table %>% mutate(sim = suppressWarnings(as.integer(sim)))

# Add 6 blocks of 30 with your names
demo_table <- demo_table %>%
  mutate(
    block = cut(
      sim,
      breaks = c(0, 30, 60, 90, 120, 150, 180),
      labels = c("miss0_y0","miss0_y3","miss50_y0","miss50_y3","miss70_y0","miss70_y3"),
      include.lowest = TRUE, right = TRUE
    )
  )

# Split by (xvar, block)
split_list <- split(demo_table, list(demo_table$xvar, demo_table$block), drop = TRUE)

out <- lapply(split_list, function(tb) {
  if (is.null(tb) || !nrow(tb)) return(tb)

  # numeric columns to summarize
  num_cols_all <- vapply(tb, is.numeric, logical(1))
  num_names    <- names(tb)[num_cols_all]

  # bucket 1: year means; bucket 2: everything else
  year_cols  <- grep("^mean_.*_yob_\\d{4}$", num_names, value = TRUE)
  other_cols <- setdiff(num_names, year_cols)

  # n for se (count sims, not any appended summary rows)
  n_sims <- sum(!is.na(tb$sim))
  if (!n_sims) return(tb)

  xv <- unique(tb$xvar)[1]
  bl <- as.character(unique(tb$block)[1])

  add_row_named <- function(label, vals) {
    tibble(sim = label, xvar = xv, block = bl) %>%
      bind_cols(as.data.frame(t(vals), stringsAsFactors = FALSE))
  }

  summarise_cols <- function(cols, suffix = "") {
    if (!length(cols)) return(list())
    
    mat  <- as.matrix(tb[, cols, drop = FALSE])
    m    <- colMeans(mat, na.rm = TRUE)
    sdev <- apply(mat, 2, sd, na.rm = TRUE)
    se   <- sdev / sqrt(n_sims)
    cv   <- ifelse(abs(m) > 0, sdev / abs(m), NA_real_)
    minv <- apply(mat, 2, min, na.rm = TRUE)
    maxv <- apply(mat, 2, max, na.rm = TRUE)
  
    list(
      add_row_named(paste0("Mean", suffix), m),
      add_row_named(paste0("sd",   suffix), sdev),
      add_row_named(paste0("se",   suffix), se),
      add_row_named(paste0("cv",   suffix), cv),
      add_row_named(paste0("min",  suffix), minv),
      add_row_named(paste0("max",  suffix), maxv)
    )
  }

  rows_other <- summarise_cols(other_cols, "")
  rows_year  <- summarise_cols(year_cols,  "_year")

  bind_rows(tb, dplyr::bind_rows(c(rows_other, rows_year)))
})

demo_table <- dplyr::bind_rows(out)
t1 <- demo_table
```

```{r}
# --- 1) Define the 24 chunk labels in the requested order --------------------
x_order   <- c("bw.tbv","fi.tbv","ych4.tbv","yco2.tbv")
miss_ord  <- c(0, 50, 70)
ycorr_ord <- c(0.00, 0.30)

# Expand in the order: for ycorr in (0.00, 0.30), for missing in (0,50,70), for x in (bw,fi,ych4,yco2)
group_meta <- purrr::map_dfr(miss_ord, function(miss) {   # outer: missing = 0,50,70
  purrr::map_dfr(ycorr_ord, function(yc) {                # inner: ycorr = 0.00,0.30
    tibble::tibble(xvar = x_order, ycorr = yc, missing = miss)
  })
}) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(group_id = dplyr::row_number()) %>%
  dplyr::select(group_id, xvar, ycorr, missing)

stopifnot(nrow(group_meta) == 24L)

# Abbreviation helpers
abbr_x <- c("bw.tbv"="bw", "fi.tbv"="fi", "ych4.tbv"="ych4", "yco2.tbv"="yco2")
abbr_y <- c("0"="y0", "0.00"="y0", "0.3"="y3", "0.30"="y3")
abbr_m <- c("0"="m0", "50"="m50", "70"="m70")

# --- 2) Split demo_table into 24 chunks of 34 rows (sequential) --------------
chunk_size <- 36L
n_chunks   <- 24L
demo_table <- dplyr::mutate(
  demo_table,
  .chunk = rep(seq_len(n_chunks), each = chunk_size)
)

chunks <- split(demo_table, demo_table$.chunk)

# --- 3) For each chunk: verify xvar matches, suffix columns, keep row index ---
prep_chunk <- function(tb, meta_row) {
  # Add row index inside chunk for joining later
  tb <- dplyr::mutate(tb, .row34 = dplyr::row_number())

  # Verify xvar column matches expected (optional but helpful)
  xvar_here <- unique(tb$xvar)
  if (length(xvar_here) != 1L || xvar_here != meta_row$xvar) {
    warning(sprintf("Chunk %d xvar mismatch: found %s, expected %s",
                    meta_row$group_id,
                    paste(xvar_here, collapse = ","),
                    meta_row$xvar))
  }

  # Build suffix like "__bw_y0_m50"
  sx <- abbr_x[[meta_row$xvar]]
  sy <- abbr_y[[as.character(meta_row$ycorr)]]
  sm <- abbr_m[[as.character(meta_row$missing)]]
  suffix <- paste0("__", sx, "_", sy, "_", sm)

  # Identify id columns & metric columns
  id_cols     <- c(".row34", "sim", "xvar", ".chunk")
  id_cols     <- intersect(id_cols, names(tb))
  metric_cols <- setdiff(names(tb), id_cols)

  # Rename metric columns with suffix
  names(tb)[match(metric_cols, names(tb))] <- paste0(metric_cols, suffix)

  # Rename sim to include suffix (kept for reference)
  if ("sim" %in% names(tb)) {
    names(tb)[names(tb) == "sim"] <- paste0("sim", suffix)
  }

  # Drop helper columns xvar/.chunk; keep .row34 and renamed metrics
  keep_cols <- c(".row34", grep(suffix, names(tb), value = TRUE))
  tb <- dplyr::select(tb, dplyr::all_of(keep_cols))
  tb
}

wide_chunks <- purrr::imap(chunks, ~prep_chunk(.x, group_meta[as.integer(.y), ]))

# --- 4) Bind side-by-side by the .row34 index -------------------------------
wide_all <- purrr::reduce(wide_chunks, ~ dplyr::full_join(.x, .y, by = ".row34")) %>%
  dplyr::arrange(.row34)
```

```{r}
# helper to grab "stat" + columns containing a substring
grab_cols <- function(df, needle) {
  keep <- c("stat", grep(needle, names(df), value = TRUE, fixed = TRUE))
  df[, keep, drop = FALSE]
}

bw_ave   <- grab_cols(ave_tbl, "__bw_y")
```

Now I will get just the correlation columns

# with PAC
```{r}
full_pac_list <- pac_sim_list
```

```{r}
# ---------- build base table over all sims & x vars ----------
x_vars <- c("bw.tbv", "fi.tbv", "ych4.tbv", "yco2.tbv")

demo_table <- dplyr::bind_rows(
  unlist(Map(function(d, i) {
    # skip sims where the PAC filter produced 0 rows (d is NULL)
    if (is.null(d) || !is.data.frame(d)) return(NULL)

    lapply(x_vars, function(xv) {
      tryCatch(
        summarise_one(d, i, x_col = xv),
        error = function(e) {
          stop(
            sprintf("Error in PAC simulation %d (x=%s): %s", i, xv, e$message),
            call. = FALSE
          )
        }
      )
    })
  }, full_pac_list, seq_along(full_pac_list)), recursive = FALSE)
)

# ---------- (sim cleanup, blocks, split, add Mean/sd/se/cv/min/max) ----------

# Ensure 'sim' is clean
if (!"sim" %in% names(demo_table)) {
  sim_like <- grep("^sim(\\.\\.\\d+)?$", names(demo_table), value = TRUE)
  if (length(sim_like)) names(demo_table)[match(sim_like[1], names(demo_table))] <- "sim"
}
demo_table <- demo_table %>% mutate(sim = suppressWarnings(as.integer(sim)))

# Add 6 blocks of 30 with your names
demo_table <- demo_table %>%
  mutate(
    block = cut(
      sim,
      breaks = c(0, 30, 60, 90, 120, 150, 180),
      labels = c("miss0_y0","miss0_y3","miss50_y0","miss50_y3","miss70_y0","miss70_y3"),
      include.lowest = TRUE, right = TRUE
    )
  )

# Split by (xvar, block)
split_list <- split(demo_table, list(demo_table$xvar, demo_table$block), drop = TRUE)

out <- lapply(split_list, function(tb) {
  if (is.null(tb) || !nrow(tb)) return(tb)

  # numeric columns to summarize
  num_cols_all <- vapply(tb, is.numeric, logical(1))
  num_names    <- names(tb)[num_cols_all]

  # bucket 1: year means; bucket 2: everything else
  year_cols  <- grep("^mean_.*_yob_\\d{4}$", num_names, value = TRUE)
  other_cols <- setdiff(num_names, year_cols)

  # n for se (count sims, not any appended summary rows)
  n_sims <- sum(!is.na(tb$sim))
  if (!n_sims) return(tb)

  xv <- unique(tb$xvar)[1]
  bl <- as.character(unique(tb$block)[1])

  add_row_named <- function(label, vals) {
    tibble(sim = label, xvar = xv, block = bl) %>%
      bind_cols(as.data.frame(t(vals), stringsAsFactors = FALSE))
  }

  summarise_cols <- function(cols, suffix = "") {
    if (!length(cols)) return(list())
    
    mat  <- as.matrix(tb[, cols, drop = FALSE])
    m    <- colMeans(mat, na.rm = TRUE)
    sdev <- apply(mat, 2, sd, na.rm = TRUE)
    se   <- sdev / sqrt(n_sims)
    cv   <- ifelse(abs(m) > 0, sdev / abs(m), NA_real_)
    minv <- apply(mat, 2, min, na.rm = TRUE)
    maxv <- apply(mat, 2, max, na.rm = TRUE)
  
    list(
      add_row_named(paste0("Mean", suffix), m),
      add_row_named(paste0("sd",   suffix), sdev),
      add_row_named(paste0("se",   suffix), se),
      add_row_named(paste0("cv",   suffix), cv),
      add_row_named(paste0("min",  suffix), minv),
      add_row_named(paste0("max",  suffix), maxv)
    )
  }


  rows_other <- summarise_cols(other_cols, "")
  rows_year  <- summarise_cols(year_cols,  "_year")

  bind_rows(tb, dplyr::bind_rows(c(rows_other, rows_year)))
})

demo_table <- dplyr::bind_rows(out)
t2_demo_table <- demo_table
```

```{r}
# --- 0) Clean the sim column name to a stable 'sim' --------------------------
sim_like <- grep("^sim($|\\.\\.\\d+)$", names(demo_table), value = TRUE)
if (length(sim_like) >= 1L) {
  names(demo_table)[names(demo_table) == sim_like[1]] <- "sim"
}

# Sanity check row count
stopifnot(nrow(demo_table) == 864)

# --- 1) Define the 24 chunk labels in the requested order --------------------
x_order   <- c("bw.tbv","fi.tbv","ych4.tbv","yco2.tbv")
miss_ord  <- c(0, 50, 70)
ycorr_ord <- c(0.00, 0.30)

# Expand in the order: for ycorr in (0.00, 0.30), for missing in (0,50,70), for x in (bw,fi,ych4,yco2)
group_meta <- purrr::map_dfr(miss_ord, function(miss) {   # outer: missing = 0,50,70
  purrr::map_dfr(ycorr_ord, function(yc) {                # inner: ycorr = 0.00,0.30
    tibble::tibble(xvar = x_order, ycorr = yc, missing = miss)
  })
}) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(group_id = dplyr::row_number()) %>%
  dplyr::select(group_id, xvar, ycorr, missing)

stopifnot(nrow(group_meta) == 24L)

# Abbreviation helpers
abbr_x <- c("bw.tbv"="bw", "fi.tbv"="fi", "ych4.tbv"="ych4", "yco2.tbv"="yco2")
abbr_y <- c("0"="y0", "0.00"="y0", "0.3"="y3", "0.30"="y3")
abbr_m <- c("0"="m0", "50"="m50", "70"="m70")

# --- 2) Split demo_table into 24 chunks of 36 rows (sequential) --------------
chunk_size <- 36L
n_chunks   <- 24L
demo_table <- demo_table %>%
  dplyr::mutate(.chunk = rep(seq_len(n_chunks), each = chunk_size))

chunks <- split(demo_table, demo_table$.chunk)

# --- 3) For each chunk: verify xvar matches, suffix columns, keep row index ---
prep_chunk <- function(tb, meta_row) {
  # Add row index inside chunk for joining later
  tb <- tb %>% dplyr::mutate(.row34 = dplyr::row_number())

  # Verify xvar column matches expected (optional but helpful)
  xvar_here <- unique(tb$xvar)
  if (length(xvar_here) != 1L || xvar_here != meta_row$xvar) {
    warning(sprintf("Chunk %d xvar mismatch: found %s, expected %s",
                    meta_row$group_id,
                    paste(xvar_here, collapse = ","),
                    meta_row$xvar))
  }

  # Build suffix like "__bw_y0_m50"
  sx <- abbr_x[[meta_row$xvar]]
  sy <- abbr_y[[as.character(meta_row$ycorr)]]
  sm <- abbr_m[[as.character(meta_row$missing)]]
  suffix <- paste0("__", sx, "_", sy, "_", sm)

  # Identify id columns & metric columns
  id_cols     <- c(".row34", "sim", "xvar", ".chunk")
  id_cols     <- intersect(id_cols, names(tb))
  metric_cols <- setdiff(names(tb), id_cols)

  # Rename metric columns with suffix
  names(tb)[match(metric_cols, names(tb))] <- paste0(metric_cols, suffix)

  # Rename sim to include suffix (kept for reference)
  if ("sim" %in% names(tb)) {
    names(tb)[names(tb) == "sim"] <- paste0("sim", suffix)
  }

  # Drop helper columns xvar/.chunk; keep .row34 and renamed metrics
  keep_cols <- c(".row34", grep(suffix, names(tb), value = TRUE))
  tb %>% dplyr::select(dplyr::all_of(keep_cols))
}

wide_chunks <- purrr::imap(chunks, ~prep_chunk(.x, group_meta[as.integer(.y), ]))

# --- 4) Bind side-by-side by the .row34 index -------------------------------
wide_all <- purrr::reduce(
  wide_chunks,
  ~ dplyr::full_join(.x, .y, by = ".row34")
) %>%
  dplyr::arrange(.row34)
```

```{r}
  t3 = t3_ave_tbl,
  t4 = t4_ave_tbl
)

sapply(tbl_list, function(df) {
  c(
    r2_uEBV = length(grep("r2_uEBV", names(df))),
    r2_mEBV = length(grep("r2_mEBV", names(df)))
  )
})
```
Now write this into final folder:


# Creating combined table
```{r}

# helper to prefix ALL column names
prefix_cols <- function(df, prefix) {
  names(df) <- paste0(prefix, names(df))
  df
}

# sanity: all tables exist and have same number of rows
stopifnot(
  exists("t1_ave_tbl"), exists("t2_ave_tbl"),
  exists("t3_ave_tbl"), exists("t4_ave_tbl")
)
stopifnot(nrow(t1_ave_tbl) == nrow(t2_ave_tbl),
          nrow(t1_ave_tbl) == nrow(t3_ave_tbl),
          nrow(t1_ave_tbl) == nrow(t4_ave_tbl))

# prefix every column (including 'stat', etc.)
t1_pref <- prefix_cols(t1_ave_tbl, "t1_")
t2_pref <- prefix_cols(t2_ave_tbl, "t2_")
t3_pref <- prefix_cols(t3_ave_tbl, "t3_")
t4_pref <- prefix_cols(t4_ave_tbl, "t4_")

# bind side-by-side in requested order
combined_prefixed <- cbind(t1_pref, t2_pref, t3_pref, t4_pref)


 
```

```{r, eval=FALSE}
out_dir <- "path/to/your/output_directory"
out_path <- file.path(out_dir, "final_combined_t1_t2_t3_t4_side_by_side.csv")
write.csv(combined_prefixed, out_path, row.names = FALSE)

message("✅ Wrote: ", out_path)
```
